verdict.rationale: The admin guide shows Keycloak records auth-related events such as brute-force lockouts, and the docs say the server can be customized with code through providers. That suggests a developer could hook into events with custom code, but nothing documents a subscribable webhook or event stream. Missing for 10: documented webhook or event-stream subscription, coverage of sign-up/sign-in/user-change events, delivery and retry semantics, an event listener configuration guide, and independent corroboration.
